name: ClusterForce
summary:
ClusterForce is an online multiplayer arcade flying sports game and a spiritual successor to Clusterball (2000). Up to eight players pilot electromagnetic gliders through 3D arenas, collect energy balls from magnetic ramps and tow them as a chain to the goal zone. Every ball raises the value of the chain but makes the glider slower and easier to hit, and only delivered balls score.

Seven ball weapons let players disrupt rivals or steal their chains, among them a homing probe that hauls a victim's balls back to the attacker. There are three modes: Catch em all, a free-for-all; Ballheist, four against four with classes; and Ballfight, in which three balls serve as lives while a boundary net closes in. The seven venues range from Ocean Arena on open water to Sky Arena above the clouds, and routes, obstacles and ball positions change with every match.
